extension.name: Figma Starter
extension.description: Turns a Figma section's screens into per-screen spec.md files, an app-level user-stories.md, and a build-order.md, then hands off to /speckit.specify.
extension.author: WaveMaker

commands.name: speckit.figma-starter.import
commands.description: Generate Figma-derived specs from a Figma section link, then hand off to /speckit.specify

hooks.prompt: Generate Spec Kit specs from a Figma section before running /speckit.specify?
hooks.description: Run the figma-images-to-spec pipeline to turn a Figma design into specs.
